messages:
alex (AE): quick sync — Kestrel POC: customer wants NLU for invoice routing + conversational help. need: success gates, golden prompts, sample dataset, timeline, and callouts for pricing/security. who can take lead on the harness?

tara (SalesEng): I can own the harness design. timeline? customer wants 4-week POC, but we should build a 6-week buffer for regressions and security.

matt (RE): agreement — propose: week1 intake & seed prompts, week2 model tuning + infra, week3 goldens + scoring, week4 run + human eval, week5 regression gating & docs, week6 buffer/hand-off.

sarah (Presales): high level acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) routing accuracy >= 88% on golden set, 2) latency 95p < 350ms for 512 tokens, 3) end-to-end fallback working for model OOMs. also need to capture UX edge cases.

jordan (Security): heads up — they require SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, and an e2e data flow diagram for our private deployment. send questionnaire by EOD.

alex (AE): pricing Q from buyer: will hosting on Dedicated change the per-token price? they want a delta estimate for committed vs hosted. tara — can you draft numbers?

tara (SalesEng): yes — rough: hosted API = $0.004/token; dedicated reserved = baseline + infra surcharge -> roughly 30% off token price but + monthly reservation. i'll put exact ranges in pricing doc.

matt (RE): for the eval harness scoring: propose hybrid scoring pipeline: automated scorer (exact match + intent match embeddings) -> human rater tier for borderline items. scoring config example: `{"score_types": ["intent_similarity","entity_accuracy","response_quality"], "intent_similarity_threshold": 0.85, "human_review_fraction": 0.12}`

sarah (Presales): golden dataset guidance: 400 seed examples covering 8 intents, 60 edge/error cases, 40 hallucination traps. split: 60% auto, 40% human-blind. we need labeled entity spans + expected routing label.

alex (AE): customer will provide 200 annotated invoices and 200 chat transcripts. we need them cleansed by Wed. add acceptance gate: if customer deliverable < 75% of expected, push timeline.

matt (RE): regression gates: any model rollout that decreases routing accuracy on the golden holdout by >2.5pts triggers rollback. automated nightly evals + alert channel. sample alert text: `ALERT: nightly-regression: routing_acc dropped 3.1 -> rolling back to v1.3`

jordan (Security): i'll own the questionnaire. one ask: we need to confirm retention — customer insists on 30-day token retention policy. confirm if we can support via dedicated/private.

tara (SalesEng): ops note: harness will use batching=dynamic and prefix cache enabled. will test quantized variants (8-bit). include cost/perf matrix in runbook.

matt (RE): sample prompt template for goldens (put in repo):
```
System: You are an invoice routing assistant.
User: {invoice_text}
Assistant: -> ROUTE: [AP/AR/OTHER] | Entities: {vendor,amount,date}
```
we'll score entity accuracy separately.

sarah (Presales): owners: Tara = harness + scoring, Matt = infra + nightly evals, Jordan = security questionnaire, Alex = customer coordination & timeline. deliverables by next Tue: draft golden set, pricing ranges, and security Q.

alex (AE): great. @tara can you drop a short PR with the harness README + example scoring config link here once ready? also, add a quick checklist for customer uploads.

tara (SalesEng): will do — aiming to post PR by Monday EOD. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deployed test environment for kestrel-poc on staging-2 (ok).

matt (RE): one last blocker: customer's data has PDFs with OCR noise — we should add OCR-normalization examples to the golden set. add 30 synthetic noisy invoices.

sarah (Presales): noted. adding to seed requirements.

ajex (AE): thanks team — i'll update the customer and sync on Mon. closing thread for now.
